label: TP
reason: User input from request.getParameter reaches response.getWriter().printf() as the format string argument (bar variable). Despite obfuscation attempts (StringBuilder wrapping, Base64 encode/decode, substring, split), none of these transformations remove or validate format specifier characters (%n, %s, %x, etc.) that would allow format string attacks. The printf call directly uses tainted user input as the format string parameter.

evidence.note: User input 'param' flows through transformations and reaches printf(format=bar) at line 70, enabling format string XSS
